backtest_protocol.execution_model: Instant unrecognized nonvested share-based-compensation award cost backlog facts are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and known only by filed date (<= signal date). The latest backlog/revenue ratio must fall versus the prior same-tag backlog point; annual revenue and gross-profit normalizers use the latest filed annual facts whose period end is <= the backlog period end. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: after the accepted SBC expense burden source, a material decline in unrecognized nonvested award compensation cost backlog relative to revenue may identify future dilution-cost relief when revenue/gross-profit health and liquid SPY-relative price confirmation are present.
interpretation: The SBC grant-value backlog relief source had positive aggregate EV/PnL, but did not clear Gate 4 because the effect was narrow and unstable: old_thin regressed -0.0278 EV and $-1,091.19, while positive PnL was dominated by too few names (max single positive share 84.87%, HHI 0.7432). It also failed the accepted distribution and accepted SBC comparators, so the unrecognized backlog decline is more likely capturing sparse seasonal vesting decay in already-strong growth names than a robust incremental dilution-quality edge. Do not promote or tune this fixed grant-value normalization bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT grant-value evidence such as closed forward replacement-value rows, option-exercise/vesting context joined to the same issuers, or a production-shared daily snapshot of grant backlog maturation. Do not sweep grant backlog tags, freshness, ratio thresholds, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

2_history_check.exp-20260616-013/exp-20260613-026: Form 4 vesting/exercise near-neighbors were weak or zero-coverage. This run uses SEC Companyfacts grant-value backlog rows instead of insider transaction rows.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-015: Accepted shared default-off recognized SBC/revenue burden improvement: aggregate EV +0.9438, PnL +$15,748.19, all three canonical windows positive.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-017: Rejected per-share buyback-adjusted SBC extension. This run tests unrecognized grant-value backlog relief, not recognized SBC per share or buyback offset.
2_history_check.playbook_current_rule: SBC threshold/tag/fact-age/top-N/notional retunes are frozen; grant-value normalization is listed as valid new evidence.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression, distribution, and accepted SBC burden standalone comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The playbook forbids nearby SBC threshold retunes but explicitly names grant-value normalization as valid new evidence. The local raw SEC Companyfacts cache exposes unrecognized nonvested award cost tags, but the item is instant/quarterly and may mostly capture normal vesting decay rather than a tradable future dilution relief edge.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC unrecognized nonvested SBC award cost backlog, missing annual revenue or gross-profit normalizer, missing prior backlog comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC instant grant-value backlog tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual revenue/gross-profit normalization, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
